name: canary-dvn-verify

scripts.mock:verify: tsx src/index.ts --no-chainlist --rpc-overrides test/no-overrides.json --metadata-file test/mock-metadata.json --deployment test/mock-deployment.json --expected test/mock-expected.json --json none --md none --rpc-timeout 5000
